primitives.name: Local Gate Condition
primitives.verbatim_quote: # GSE — Next Safe Queue (30 tasks) Each task lists: **[scope]** what · **gate** (LOCAL = no approval needed within the lane; GATED = owner approval required) · done-condition.
primitives.assumptions: Execution path is deterministic based on gate type; no cross-gate transitions occur without explicit GATED flag.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When L=1 and G=0, task executes without owner approval.

layer2.mapping: Task execution state maps to binary logic of approval dependency; L=1 implies no external validation required.
layer2.telemetry: Verification of task completion without global gate violation.

primitives.name: Global Gate Violation Check
primitives.verbatim_quote: No task here crosses a global gate without an explicit GATED flag.
primitives.assumptions: All tasks must be explicitly marked GATED if they involve global resources.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If V=1, then F=0, indicating unauthorized access.

layer2.mapping: Enforces constraint that all inter-domain operations require explicit permission via GATED flag.
layer2.telemetry: Audit trail of flagged vs unflagged global resource access.
